::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_11 — The Platform Question: Database Consolidation Toward SSOT
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Books 01 through 10 answered the authentication question. This book asks what the estate looks like when the authentication answer exposes the platform question underneath it. Every SQL Server instance that survived the migration is a re-authenticated silo. The SSOT goal requires examining whether those silos should persist — or consolidate into one authoritative database platform. (UIAO_135 §1.2)
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="default"}
## Status — Draft
This book extends the SQL Server Identity Transformation series into database platform modernization. It is **DRAFT v0.1**, published for review alongside the companion authentication narrative. Platform consolidation decisions documented here are analytical — they do not carry normative ADR weight until the relevant ADRs are proposed and accepted.
:::
